description: This Java class defines a set of variables and associated methods for handling context-specific information related to code generation, particularly for generating header/source files and JSON serialization/deserialization functions. It holds configuration details such as file names, function names, and mappings for getter/setter functions used in code generation workflows.

classes.name: ContextNative
classes.description: A class encapsulating context variables used during code generation, including file names, JSON encode/decode functions, object creation/destruction functions, and getter/setter mappings.

methods.name: wasGenerated
methods.description: Returns true if either the header or source file name has been set, indicating that the context was used for code generation.

methods.name: getHeaderFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the header file name associated with this context.

methods.name: setHeaderFileName
methods.description: Sets the header file name for this context.

methods.name: getSourceFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the source file name associated with this context.

methods.name: setSourceFileName
methods.description: Sets the source file name for this context.

methods.name: getEncodeFunctionName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the encoding function used for JSON serialization.

methods.name: setEncodeFunctionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the encoding function used for JSON serialization.

methods.name: getDecodeFunctionName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the decoding function used for JSON deserialization.

methods.name: setDecodeFunctionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the decoding function used for JSON deserialization.

methods.name: getCreateFunctionName
methods.description: Retrieves the function name used for object creation/initialization.

methods.name: setCreateFunctionName
methods.description: Sets the function name used for object creation/initialization.

methods.name: getDestroyFunctionName
methods.description: Retrieves the function name used for destroying/deallocating the object.

methods.name: setDestroyFunctionName
methods.description: Sets the function name used for destroying/deallocating the object.

methods.name: getDestroyFromListFunctionName
methods.description: Retrieves the function name used for destroying list items.

methods.name: setDestroyFromListFunctionName
methods.description: Sets the function name used for destroying list items.

methods.name: getDestroyFromMapFunctionName
methods.description: Retrieves the function name used for destroying map entries.

methods.name: setDestroyFromMapFunctionName
methods.description: Sets the function name used for destroying map entries.

methods.name: addGetFunction
methods.description: Associates a variable name with its getter function name in the context.

methods.name: getGetFunctionForVar
methods.description: Retrieves the getter function name associated with a given variable.

methods.name: addSetFunction
methods.description: Associates a variable name with its setter function name in the context.

methods.name: getSetFunctionForVar
methods.description: Retrieves the setter function name associated with a given variable.
